hints.fleet: Online means a heartbeat within 15 minutes. Low battery is under 20%. Use search and filters to find a device, then open policy from Configure.
hints.map: Latest GPS pin per device. Green is online (heartbeat within 15 minutes); gray is offline.
hints.provisioning: Scan the QR on a factory-reset Android device. Pre-assign a device ID to mint a deviceToken in ADMIN_EXTRAS_BUNDLE; the DPC must send it as X-Device-Token.
hints.settings: Publish APK metadata without redeploying the hub. Drop an APK to parse version metadata, store it in the dpc-releases bucket, and activate it for UpdateWorker.
hints.console: Dispatch a goal to the specialist desks. Policy writes and Zero-Touch QR also live on Fleet and Provisioning.
hints.guide: Step-by-step onboarding for new devices and fleet checks — from preparation through basic troubleshooting.

provisioning.step1Body: Factory-reset the Android device so it returns to the welcome screen.
provisioning.step2Body: On the welcome screen, tap the same spot six times to open QR setup.
provisioning.step3Body: Scan this QR. The device downloads the DPC APK, verifies the signing-certificate checksum, and becomes Device Owner.
provisioning.hint: QR encodes Android Enterprise extras. With a device ID, extras include deviceToken — the DPC stores it and sends X-Device-Token on heartbeat/policy. Checksum is SHA-256 (base64url) of the published APK.

guide.heroTitle: Enroll devices and verify the fleet step by step
guide.heroBody: Follow these five steps to prepare an Android phone as Device Owner, confirm it in the console, and handle common issues yourself.
guide.step1Summary: Get the handset ready for Zero-Touch so QR setup succeeds on the first try.
guide.step1Bullet1: Back up anything you need, then confirm the device runs Android 9.0 or newer.
guide.step1Bullet2: Factory reset the phone so it returns to a brand-new out-of-box welcome screen.
guide.step1Tip: Tip: Do not enroll a phone that still has a Google account or personal apps — factory reset first.
guide.step2Summary: Launch the QR scanner from the welcome screen without using Play Store.
guide.step2Bullet1: On the first welcome screen, tap an empty area six times in a row.
guide.step2Bullet2: The phone opens the QR camera and prompts you to connect Wi-Fi.
guide.step2Tip: Note: If the camera does not open, wait until the welcome screen finishes loading, or reboot and try again.
guide.step3Summary: Scan the console QR to install Sabuy DPC and become Device Owner.
guide.step3Bullet1: Open the console page «Provisioning» to show the enrollment QR Code.
guide.step3Bullet2: Scan the QR — the phone downloads and installs Sabuy DPC automatically without Play Store.
guide.step3Bullet3: Accept Device Owner permissions when the on-device prompts appear.
guide.step3Tip: Tip: Pre-assign a device ID in the console before generating the QR so the handset joins the fleet immediately.
guide.step4Summary: Confirm the device checked in and is running the latest app version.
guide.step4Bullet1: Open «Devices» and confirm the handset shows a green online status.
guide.step4Bullet2: Check that the app version reads «Up to date».
guide.step4Tip: Online means a heartbeat within 15 minutes. After a fresh enroll, wait a moment and refresh.
guide.step5Summary: A short checklist when scanning fails or status does not update.
guide.step5Bullet1: QR scan does nothing: verify Wi-Fi is stable, then regenerate the QR if needed.
guide.step5Bullet2: Status never updates: check SIM/Wi-Fi internet and background service permissions.
guide.step5Tip: If it still fails, factory reset and restart from Step 1, or contact ops with the device ID.
